title: Meeting Steven Greer at a Boulder book signing
summary: Michael Herrera tells of Meeting Steven Greer at a Boulder book signing, about 2018 at Boulder, Colorado, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he stood up and handed me his card and he was like, "Don't tell anybody this information.

plain: Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a huge UFO in the Indonesian jungle, says that in 2018 he went to a book signing in Boulder, Colorado, held by an author named Steven Greer. He says that after he shared his story, Greer stood up, handed him his card and told him, "Don't tell anybody this information." He tells it because, if true, it shows his account was taken seriously and treated as sensitive.
